faq.title: Questions
faq.subtitle: Briefly about how the Izoh works and what is best to configure first.

guestEntry.title: How do guests open the form?
guestEntry.body: Via QR code or link. You can create separate QR codes for tables, the counter, or other spots, and the context will be saved with the guest message.

setup.title: What should you configure first?
setup.body: Leave only the necessary forms, add a logo and check the text for guests. This will make the shape feel like part of your space.

staff.title: When is staff needed?
staff.body: If it is important for guests to choose an employee or team. This helps you quickly understand who was thanked or where help is needed.

notifications.title: How do notifications arrive?
notifications.body: You can receive requests in a personal chat or group Telegram. It is better not to lose important complaints and low ratings.

support.title: Need help?
support.body: Write to Telegram if something doesn’t open, looks strange, or you want to discuss the setup.
